pieces.description: Heather-grey cotton fleece sweatpants. The waistband is a FLAT elastic band with the drawcord tucked INSIDE it (nothing hanging). Through the hips and seat the fleece lies flat against the body like a fitted yoke - seen from the SIDE the front of the hips is flat (no pouch, no bulge) and the seat follows the body. From mid-thigh down the legs are relaxed and baggy, ending in loose gathered cuffs at the TOP of the ankle (where a high-top sneaker's collar sits, two fingers above the ankle bone) that stand clearly off the ankle all round, the whole foot and ankle bone visible below them. Side-seam pockets sewn flat, and a small embroidered patch on the upper left thigh: a cute red-and-white mushroom whose cap forms the letter C (a parody sportswear logo).
